Off by default. When on, the cropped picture of each card you confirm is shared to help train open card recognition.

When you confirm a scanned card (added automatically, or confirmed in Review), the app uploads the cropped picture of that card together with the card id and the card's language. Nothing else: no location, no device or account data, and the picture is saved without any metadata.

You release these pictures into the public domain under CC0 1.0 (creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0). Anyone may use them for any purpose, including training recognition models, without credit.

You can withdraw a picture or all of them at any time under My contributions. A withdrawn picture is deleted from the server right away and left out of every future dataset release. Releases already published keep it, because copies of them can't be called back.
